title: 第2章 重新做人
content_zh:
第2章重新做人
话说回来，大明朝的皇帝一个个都是狠人，也亏得他的这个姐夫是后世的洪熙皇帝，若换做其他人，这么个小舅哥，早他娘的拉去沉塘了。
当然……话虽如此，张安世却还是将姐夫当作自己至亲的，为了姐夫，也得要改变自己的形象了，免得让自己的恶名成为姐夫被人攻击的口实。
好，决定了，重新做人，要立竿见影的那种！
张安世起了个大早，那张三招呼人安排了洗漱。
张家的宅邸占地不大，南京城毕竟寸土寸金，再加上父亲早亡，而姐夫朱高炽虽然是太子，可是地位却颇为尴尬，靖难之役后，永乐皇帝论功行赏，也给许多功臣安排了宅邸，张家终究排不上号，就这宅子，却都还是朱高炽亲自过问讨来的。
洗漱一番后，张三探头探脑地进来，道：“公子，朱少爷来了。”
朱少爷……
在大明，姓朱而不是皇亲，有资格被张三称之为少爷的……只有一个人……那便是当朝成国公之子——朱勇了。
这家伙一向是张安世的狐朋狗友。
果然，张安世还没反应，随即便听到了笑声，接着便见朱勇迫不及待地冲了进来。
此时的朱勇虽也只是个十二三岁的少年，身材却很魁梧，只见他捋着袖子，手里拎着一个漆盒，高声道：“安世，安世，快看，我寻了一个好蝈蝈，嘻嘻……状的似头牛……”
张安世一见到朱勇，骤然之间，好像一下子通达了。
自己的名声……好像有救了。
一念至此，张安世看着朱勇的眼眸都明亮了几分，大笑道：“你来的正好，走，我们入学去。”
“入学？”朱勇一听，眼珠子要了掉下来了，惊愕地道：“俺们兄弟二人，可逃学小半月了，安世没有疯吧……”
张安世却用奇怪的眼神看着他：“不会吧，不会吧，这世上莫非还有你这种不爱学习的人？”
清晨的南京城，弥漫着霭霭雾气，这薄雾似吹不开，伴着朝露，给人一种清凉之感。
张安世和朱勇坐着马车，马车的车轱辘在这青石板的路上。
时候虽早，却已有许多人隐在薄雾之中，开始了一日的生计。

而张安世和朱勇从前读书的学堂其实就设在文庙不远的一处偏僻角落，此地也是国子监祭酒胡俨的居所，两进的院落，因为来读书的勋臣子弟并不多，书堂也只是临时性的，胡俨的教学，就在前院里进行。
永乐皇帝深感教育对于子弟的重要，所以特别下旨，命国子监祭酒胡俨在此开设了一个内学堂，招揽功臣勋贵子弟来此就读。
此时还是大清早，已有三三两两的少年来了。
照着规矩，这个时候胡俨坐在明伦堂中，稳稳坐定，所有来读书的少年则鱼贯而入，先去给胡俨行师礼。
张安世和朱勇一到，立即引发了一阵轰动，显然这二位是老油条，他们来学里就如同太阳打西边出来。
张安世不以为意，进入了明伦堂，也学着其他人的样子朝胡俨行礼：“学生张安世，见过恩师。”
“张安世……”胡俨依旧面无表情，这个太子的小舅子，一个纨绔子而已，从前也来读过几日的书，不过很快就没有来了。
当然胡俨也不在乎，此等皇亲国戚和功勋子弟，大多本就是凭借着祖荫混吃等死，陛下命他在此开课讲学，其实也不指望他们真正学到什么本事，别给这南京城的百姓添乱便好了。
胡俨于是木然地点点头。
从一开始，胡俨就好像一个木桩子一样，似乎看不到喜怒，面上也没有丝毫的波澜。
等三三两两的少年来了十七八个，胡俨方才道：“时辰到了，应到三十九人，实至十七人……”
胡俨似乎并没有因为缺课率过多而恼怒，依旧气定神闲。
涵养，懂不懂？
这一届学生，他是带不动的。
涵养不够，早就气死了。
胡俨随手捡起茶几上的书，道：“今日……依旧讲一讲《尚书》，尚书之中：侮慢自贤，反道败德之意吧。”
胡俨宛如一个道德先生，似乎对于这些少年，最喜欢就是将四书五经之中关于道德的文章拿来讲一讲。
少年们一个个开始昏昏入睡。
张安世的眼皮子也开始打架。
直到一声梆子响，张安世猛然惊醒。

似乎胡俨比张安世更加期待这个声音，他道：“好了，下课。”
说罢，便头也不回地踏步而去。
明伦堂里顿时传出欢呼。
一群少年各自寻觅自己相熟的人开始叽叽喳喳起来。
张安世也没想到，自己在学里居然颇受欢迎，立即有一群少年围了上来，张安世凭借着记忆，先是认出了一个小个子的少年张軏。
只见张軏道：“张兄咋今日来入学？”
这个张軏，在历史上当然默默无闻，不过他爹河间王张玉，却是永乐皇帝靖难时的名将，张玉在作战之中，为了保护永乐皇帝而战死，永乐皇帝大为悲痛，于是追封张玉为河间王。
张軏只是张玉的小儿子，他的兄长张辅，如今已是五军都督府的指挥使同知，除此之外，他的姑姑则是永乐皇帝的贵妃。
不过这小子年纪还小，在学里也属于小辈，此时还最是推崇张安世这样敢于逃学的人。
张安世笑呵呵地道：“入学当然是来读书的，我要学好文武艺，做个有用之人。”
他话音落下，一旁的朱勇已经从袖子里掏出了他的漆盒，口里道：“来，来，都来瞧瞧我的蝈蝈。”
众人便都被朱勇吸引。
张安世摇头道：“蝈蝈有什么好玩的。”
朱勇是张安世的死党，立即道：“咋，安世还有啥好玩的不成？”
张安世叹口气道：“我这些日子，在家中读书……”
少年们听到这里，顿时露出了不可思议的样子。
张安世又道：“在家中读书之后，猛然顿悟，突然想到，我等皇亲国戚，怎么能成日混吃等死呢？不能，我们将来是要干大事的。”
听说干大事，少年们一个个浑身热血上涌起来。
这些家伙们平日里养尊处优，又正是最血气方刚的时候，唯恐天下不乱，尤其是那张軏，兴致勃勃地道：“干什么大事，算俺一个。”
张安世笑吟吟地看着张軏道：“你……年纪太小了，胆子也不够大……”

张軏闻言，立即大怒道：“我胆大的很。”
张安世只好叹了口气，从袖里变戏法似的，居然掏出一个炮仗出来。
这真的是个炮仗，此时鞭炮已经十分普遍，可张安世手中的炮仗，显然是加大款，足有小半的拳头一样大。
张安世道：“伱玩过炮仗吗？”
张軏道：“咋没玩过？逢年过节，家里的炮仗都是俺亲自点的。”
张安世顿时一副终于寻到了一个人才的模样：“点炮仗不算本事，你敢拿炮仗炸粪坑吗？”
张軏一下子来了精神，喃喃道：“对呀，我怎么没想到，张大哥，我真钦佩你，你竟能想到这个。”
张安世笑呵呵地摇头：“拿炮仗炸粪坑其实也不算本事。”
学堂里此时已分为了两派，有七八人依旧坐在自己的课桌上认真地看着书，对此充耳不闻之外，其余几个少年，则是一个个好奇宝宝似地围着张安世，如饥似渴。
张安世压低声音道：“就是不晓得，有没有人敢在严先生出恭时……”
好家伙，许多人倒吸了一口凉气。
张軏擦了擦即将要从鼻里流出来的鼻涕，也不禁心怯。
“算了……”
“俺敢！”张軏较真起来。
content_en:
Chapter 2 Become a new person
Having said that, all the emperors of the Ming Dynasty were ruthless, and luckily his brother-in-law was the later Emperor Hongxi. If it had been anyone else, such a brother-in-law would have been dragged to Shen Tang long ago.
Of course... having said that, Zhang Anshi still regarded his brother-in-law as his closest relative. For the sake of his brother-in-law, he had to change his image, lest his notoriety become an excuse for his brother-in-law to be attacked.
Okay, I’ve decided to start a new life and get immediate results!
Zhang Anshi got up early, and Zhang San called people to arrange washing.
The Zhang family's mansion occupies a small area. After all, Nanjing city has a lot of money. In addition, his father died early. Although his brother-in-law Zhu Gaochi is the prince, his status is quite embarrassing. After the Jingnan Campaign, Emperor Yongle rewarded many meritorious officials and arranged mansions for many meritorious officials. After all, the Zhang family was not ranked among them. However, Zhu Gaochi had to ask for this mansion personally.
After washing up, Zhang San poked his head in and said, "Sir, Master Zhu is here."
Master Zhu...
In the Ming Dynasty, the surname was Zhu rather than a relative of the emperor. There was only one person who was qualified to be called the young master by Zhang San... and that was Zhu Yong, the son of Duke Cheng of the current dynasty.
This guy has always been Zhang Anshi's best friend.
Sure enough, before Zhang Anshi could react, he heard laughter and then saw Zhu Yong rushing in impatiently.
At this time, although Zhu Yong was only a boy of 12 or 13 years old, he was very tall. He was rolling up his sleeves and holding a lacquer box in his hand. He said loudly: "An Shi, An Shi, look, I found a good grasshopper, hehe... it looks like a cow..."
As soon as Zhang Anshi saw Zhu Yong, he suddenly seemed to understand.
My reputation... seems to be saved.
As soon as he thought about this, Zhang Anshi looked at Zhu Yong's eyes and his eyes brightened a little, and he laughed and said: "You came just in time, let's go to school."
"Enrollment?" When Zhu Yong heard this, his eyes almost dropped, and he said in shock: "We two brothers have been skipping school for half a month. An Shi is not crazy..."
Zhang Anshi looked at him with strange eyes: "No, no, are there people like you in the world who don't like to study?"
In the early morning, the city of Nanjing is filled with mist. This mist seems to be hard to blow away, and along with the morning dew, it gives people a sense of coolness.
Zhang Anshi and Zhu Yong were riding in a carriage, and the carriage's wheels were on the bluestone road.
Although it was early, there were already many people hiding in the mist and starting their day's work.
The school where Zhang Anshi and Zhu Yong used to study was actually located in a remote corner not far from the Confucian Temple. This place was also the residence of Hu Yan, the imperial wine worshipper of the Imperial Academy. There were two courtyards. Because there were not many children of honorary ministers who came to study, the school hall was only temporary. Hu Yan's teaching was conducted in the front yard.
Emperor Yongle deeply felt the importance of education for his children, so he issued a special order to order Hu Yan, the Imperial Academy's Jijiu Jiu, to open an inner school here to recruit the children of meritorious officials and nobles to study here.
It was still early in the morning, and there were already young people arriving in twos and threes.
According to the rules, Hu Yan was sitting firmly in the Minglun Hall at this time, and all the young people who came to study filed in and went to pay homage to Hu Yan first.
The arrival of Zhang Anshi and Zhu Yong immediately caused a sensation. It was obvious that these two were seasoned students, and their arrival at the school was like the sun rising in the west.
Zhang Anshi didn't take it seriously and entered Minglun Hall. He also followed the example of others and saluted Hu Yan: "Student Zhang Anshi, I have met my mentor."
"Zhang Anshi..." Hu Yan remained expressionless. This prince's brother-in-law was just a dandy. He had come here to study for a few days before, but he stopped coming soon.
Of course, Hu Yan doesn't care. Most of these royal relatives and meritorious children are just relying on their ancestors to live and die. His Majesty ordered him to give lectures here. In fact, he doesn't expect them to really learn any skills. Don't give this to the hundreds of people in Nanjing City.Just add some confusion to the surname.
Hu Yan nodded numbly.
From the beginning, Hu Yan was like a wooden stake. He seemed to have no mood or anger, and there was no wave on his face.
When seventeen or eight young men arrived in twos and threes, Hu Yan just said: "The time has come, there should be thirty-nine people, but in fact there are seventeen..."
Hu Yan didn't seem to be angry because of the excessive absenteeism rate, and remained calm and composed.
Self-restraint, do you understand?
He cannot lead this class of students.
If you don't have enough self-cultivation, you will be angry to death a long time ago.
Hu Yan casually picked up the book on the coffee table and said: "Today... I will still talk about the Book of Ministers. In the Book of Ministers, it means insulting one's own virtuous people and going against the moral principles."
Hu Yan is like a moral gentleman. It seems that his favorite thing for these teenagers is to talk about moral articles from the Four Books and Five Classics.
One by one, the teenagers began to fall asleep.
Zhang Anshi's eyelids also started to fight.
Until there was a bang, Zhang Anshi suddenly woke up.
It seemed that Hu Yan was looking forward to this voice more than Zhang Anshi. He said: "Okay, get out of class is over."
After that, he walked away without looking back.
Cheers suddenly erupted in Minglun Hall.
A group of teenagers began to chatter each other looking for people they knew.
Zhang Anshi also didn't expect that he would be quite popular in school. A group of teenagers immediately gathered around him. Zhang Anshi relied on his memory to first recognize a small teenager named Zhang Fu.
I saw Zhang Fu saying, "Brother Zhang, why did you come to school today?"
This Zhang Fu is of course unknown in history, but his father Zhang Yu, king of Hejian, was a famous general during Emperor Yongle's calamity. Zhang Yu died in battle to protect Emperor Yongle. Emperor Yongle was deeply saddened, so he posthumously named Zhang Yu King of Hejian.
Zhang Fu is only Zhang Yu's youngest son. His elder brother Zhang Fu is now the commander of the Fifth Army Governor's Mansion. In addition, his aunt is the concubine of Emperor Yongle.
However, this boy is still young and belongs to the junior class in school. At this time, people like Zhang Anshi who dare to skip school are the most respected.
Zhang Anshi said with a smile: "Of course I am here to study. I want to learn literary and martial arts well and become a useful person."
When he finished speaking, Zhu Yong beside him had already taken out his lacquer box from his sleeve and said, "Come on, come on, come and take a look at my grasshopper."
Everyone was attracted by Zhu Yong.
Zhang Anshi shook his head and said, "What's so fun about a grasshopper?"
Zhu Yong was Zhang Anshi's best friend, and he immediately said: "Hey, is there anything else fun that Anshi can do?"
Zhang Anshi sighed and said: "I am studying at home these days..."
When the teenagers heard this, they suddenly looked incredulous.
Zhang Anshi added: "After studying at home, I suddenly had an epiphany. It suddenly occurred to me, how can we and other relatives of the emperor eat and wait to die all day long? No, we will do big things in the future."
When they heard that they were doing something big, the young people's blood surged up all over their bodies.
These guys usually live their lives in a dignified manner, but it is also when they are at their most energetic, fearing that the world will not be in chaos, especially Zhang Fu, who said with great interest: "If you are doing something big, count me in."
Zhang Anshi looked at Zhang Fu with a smile and said: "You... are too young and not courageous enough..."
Zhang Fu heard this and immediately said angrily: "I am very bold."
Zhang Anshi had no choice but to sigh, and like a magic trick, he actually pulled out a firecracker from his sleeve.
This was really a firecracker. Firecrackers were very common at this time, but the firecracker in Zhang Anshi's hands was obviously an enlarged version, as big as half a fist.
Zhang Anshi said: "Have you ever played firecrackers?"
Zhang Fu said: "Why haven't you played before? During the holidays, I order all the firecrackers at home myself."
Zhang Anshi suddenly looked like he had finally found a talent: "Lighting up firecrackers is not a skill. Do you dare to use firecrackers to blow up a cesspool?"
Zhang Fu suddenly became energetic and murmured: "Yes, why didn't I think about it?"Come on, Brother Zhang, I really admire you, you can think of this. "
Zhang Anshi shook his head with a smile: "Using firecrackers to blow up manure pits is actually not a skill. "
The school was divided into two groups at this time. Seven or eight people were still sitting on their desks and reading books seriously, turning a deaf ear to it. The other teenagers were surrounding Zhang Anshi like curious babies, hungry and thirsty.
Zhang Anshi lowered his voice and said: "I just don't know if anyone dares to pay tribute to Mr. Yan..."
Boy, many people gasped.
Zhang Fu wiped the mucus that was about to flow out of his nose and couldn't help feeling timid.
"Forget it..."
"I dare! "Zhang Fu became more serious.
